description.text: The second expansion of the EX series, released in September 2003 with 100 cards. It centers on Fossil Pokémon, with a fossil card for each line, and was the first set whose Pokémon can have two Weaknesses or two Resistances. It gave English players Rare Candy, Multi Energy and Lanette's Net Search and brought Eevee back, and its Wailord ex has 200 HP. Its theme decks were Caravan and Oasis.

description.text: The copy with the "Prerelease" stamp, the promo card given to players at the EX Sandstorm prerelease tournaments. It was the first prerelease promo of Pokémon USA, and the first English prerelease promo since Misty's Seadra for Gym Heroes.

description.text: A Cosmos holofoil copy given out as the Pokémon League reward of the February 2004 season, the sixth of the 2003-2004 Hoenn cycle (Bulbapedia's set lists call it the e-League). A gold Winner-stamped copy came from the same season.

tell.text: A foil "winner" stamp on the picture: lowercase with a star on Wizards of the Coast cards, "WINNER" beside a Poké Ball on later ones. Cosmos foil whose dots and circles are blocky, as if made of pixels, not smooth.

description.text: A cosmos holofoil copy with a "Winner" stamp in the bottom right corner of the picture, the winners' prize of the Pokémon e-League in February 2004. Everyone who attended got the copy without the stamp.

tell.text: A foil "winner" stamp on the picture: lowercase with a star on Wizards of the Coast cards, "WINNER" beside a Poké Ball on later ones. An oversized copy, several times a playing card's size.

description.text: A jumbo copy of the Winner card, one in each Pokémon League kit of February 2004, the sixth season of the 2003-2004 League year (Bulbapedia's set lists call it the e-League). League kits held a jumbo every month from September 2003 to March 2004, except December.
